_comment: Featured repositories shown in README order. Descriptions are customized for Noshin Nawar's projects.

projects.description: Real-time Bangla sign language recognition using a CNN-based computer vision model, supporting 47 gestures with an 82% recognition accuracy.
A deployed cyberbullying detection platform using NLP and machine learning, with an 85% classification accuracy and a Flask web interface.
An interactive operating-system simulator built with Python and Pygame, demonstrating Round Robin scheduling, process states, and real-time memory visualization.
A unified cloud storage system integrating Google Drive and Dropbox with JWT authentication, role-based access, REST APIs, MySQL, and Telegram bot integration.
